test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

Donny said, “I can swim fast.”

options.text: Donny said that she had swum fast.
Donny said that she will swim fast
Donny said that she could swim fast.
Donny said that she could not swim fast.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Donny said that she could swim fast."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The rules for changing direct speech to indirect speech are:
 
 
• In indirect speech, the verb tense often changes from present to past and from past to past perfect.
 
• 'Can' changes to 'Could.'
 
• The reporting verb said/said to is changed to told, asked, demanded, ordered, and enquired as per the nature of the sentence.
 
• We must remove the commas and inverted commas.
 
• The first person in the reported speech changes according to the subject of the reporting speech.
 
• We must use 'that' in the sentence of indirect speech.
 
• The pronoun "I" changes to "she" in indirect speech.
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *Shakespeare said, “I can write another drama tomorrow.” *(Direct speech)
 
• *Shakespeare said that he could write another drama the next day.* (Indirect speech)
 
 
 
 
 
• ​Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.
